speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: when did your right leg weakness and memory problems first start, and have you noticed any changes in your vision or hearing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neurosyphilis (Tabes dorsalis with general paresis). I need you to undergo a Lumbar_Puncture and a Serum_RPR to confirm this immediately. Also, please have your family monitor for any new visual disturbances, such as loss of color vision.
